name: 19081 · Swarthmore, PA
findings: ZIP 19081 (Swarthmore) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19081 (Swarthmore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19081 (Swarthmore) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
